patch_list: Installs Reolink under its own package name, alongside the Reolink from the Play Store. On by default, because a patched copy cannot update the Play Store Reolink.
Changes Reolink's app name and launcher icon. Defaults to "Reolink AA" with the Reolink AA icon; Reolink's original icon is also available.

On a car screen, shows Reolink's phone layout across the whole width: the overview and the camera page with its controls, Playback and Quick reply. Full screen still shows the video alone, and Back returns from it and then to the overview,…

Declares Reolink a parked video app, so Android Auto and car hosts like DriveDeck list it on the car screen by themselves. Android Auto still needs Unknown sources in its developer settings for a patched app.
